method: Manual CUA browser inspection and read-only DOM measurements in the Codex in-app browser. Screenshots were inspected in the conversation; no image files are claimed here.
coverageNote: Full feedback-to-revision journeys ran during implementation. After the final index and copy/CSS changes, the rebuilt UI was checked again for task navigation, long content, empty views, invalid-cursor recovery, header, tap targets and keyboard focus. Native mobile Safari and a physical phone were not tested.

checks.name: desktop-journey
checks.observation: At 1280×720, opened an older saved result, inspected two changed files, submitted realistic payout rounding feedback, and saw the saved unapproved revision (Attempts 2).

checks.name: phone-journey
checks.observation: At 390×844, opened the date-range result, inspected changes and the explicit missing-check/path-mismatch state, submitted boundary-case feedback, and saw the saved unapproved revision (Attempts 2).

checks.name: pagination
checks.observation: The synthetic 92-family fixture showed exact counts and pages of 40, 40 and 12 without overlap; the last page omitted Next page.

checks.name: phone-long-content
checks.observation: Long synthetic titles wrapped without horizontal overflow; final document width equaled 390px.

checks.name: desktop-long-content
checks.observation: Long titles wrapped inside the desktop row; final document width equaled 1280px.

checks.name: tap-targets
checks.observation: Final rebuilt task-list actions measured 44px high on desktop and phone.

checks.name: empty-view
checks.observation: Phone Complete 0 showed a concise empty state and See all tasks; desktop empty project showed zero counts and Start in chat.

checks.name: invalid-cursor
checks.observation: An invalid page cursor showed an explicit expired-page message with a working Back link, without a server error or blank view.

checks.name: keyboard
checks.observation: Tab on the final desktop build visibly focused Skip to content with an outline.

checks.name: simplicity
checks.observation: Removed duplicate generic task/scope instructions from list rows; shortened the phone task header from the internal ID to Task. Rebuilt and visually inspected both repairs.
